record.field: City of Joburg Property Company fleet vehicle usage policy covering authorization, responsibilities, and usage guidelines for all company vehicles.
Fleet Vehicle Usage After Business Hours and Weekends
Policy governing the use of company vehicles after business hours and on weekends. Requires prior authorization from department manager and fleet office. Valid for specific date ranges only.
Regular maintenance schedule and procedures for all JPC fleet vehicles. Includes daily checks, service intervals, and reporting requirements.
Vehicle Accident and Incident Reporting Policy
Procedures for reporting vehicle accidents and incidents. Includes requirements for police reports, insurance claims, witness statements, and immediate notification to fleet office.
